name.description: What people call it: one line of 1 to 100 characters, with no space at either end.

only.description: The condition under which the thing is there at all, begun with "when", "on" or "for", so that it reads after the word "only": `only: when a customer pays by card`. One line of at most 100 characters. Left out when it is always there.

description.description: What it is responsible for, in 1 to 2,000 characters. Its first sentence says what the thing is: a box shows that sentence.

external.description: `true`: the people this model is kept for cannot change the system. Left out for a system of yours, and when nobody has said.

owner.description: The id of the owner, a record in owners/, who answers for the system. Left out when nobody has said.

repository.description: The id of the repository its code is in, a record in repositories/: written on the system only when the code of all its apps is there, else on each app. Left out when it is the one the model's folder lies in, and when nobody has said.

description: Software its users see as one whole, ours or somebody else's. Nothing is above it. C4 calls it a software system.
